authorship: Expected values written by hand by Claude (architect), checked against a separate Claude-only reference implementation, committed by Avi. Codex must never edit this file. If a case fails and you believe the expected value is wrong, stop and report the case ID and your reasoning.

interface.modules: pipeline.runner (the writer) and scripts/build_data.py (the command; load it in tests with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location).
interface.errors: RunError is defined in pipeline.runner. Bad arguments raise the built-in ValueError.
interface.run(registry, fetch, today, out_dir): Section 10.2. fetch(data, as_of_month) returns rows. Returns the summary.
interface.main(argv, environ, today, out, root, ma: scripts/build_data.py, section 10.3. Returns the exit code. No argument has a default: only the script's own entry point passes the real fetch.

case_fields.registry / registry_edits: The registry below, deep-copied, with edits applied as in publish.json.
case_fields.rows / rows_edits: The rows below, deep-copied, with edits applied. The fake fetch(data, as_of_month) records data["symbol"], then returns a deep copy of rows[data["symbol"]], unless fetch_failures names that symbol.
case_fields.fetch_failures: {symbol: {"raise": TypeName, "message": text}}: the fake fetch raises that type with that message. TypeName is ProviderError (from pipeline.providers) or RuntimeError.
case_fields.today: YYYY-MM-DD: build a datetime.date. today_datetime: build a datetime.datetime.
case_fields.before_files: Files to create in the output folder before the run: name to text. A value of {"folder": true} creates a subfolder instead.
case_fields.out_dir_missing: If true, run() is given a path to a folder that does not exist.
case_fields.expected_fetch_order: The symbols the fake fetch was called with, in order.
case_fields.expected_files: After the run, the output folder holds exactly these names (including any before_files kept). Each name in expected_documents must hold exactly json.dumps(document, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n", where the test builds the document itself from the same edited rows with the library functions in section 10.2 step 4 (build_monthly_series, analyse, build_document). Every other name must hold exactly its before_files text.
case_fields.expected_summary: run() only: the returned summary, compared exactly.
case_fields.expected_error / message_equals / messag: As in the other golden files. message_equals compares the whole message.
case_fields.canaries: Every run and cli case: every row value, written as text (a string as given, a number as repr() gives it), must not appear in any file in the output folder or in anything main() wrote to out.
case_fields.cli: main() cases: root is a new temporary folder containing pipeline/instruments.json (the registry, or registry_text if given); out is a StringIO; make_fetch is a fake that records the keys dictionary it is given and returns the fake fetch, unless make_fetch_raises gives a RuntimeError message to raise instead. expected_stdout is the exact list of lines written. expected_keys is the dictionary make_fetch received, or null if it must not be called. data/derived is the output folder; expected_files as above, or null if the folder must not exist.

registry.about: Synthetic instrument list for runner tests.

cases.derivation: Run on 28 Sept: as-of August. Fetch order is exchange rate, benchmark, then assets in list order. September rows are dropped; crypto's April row is before its start. Four month-ends each (May to August), which is 3 months elapsed: the summary counts month-ends. The benchmark gets no file.
Last run's usa.json is replaced. A name starting with a dot (macOS Finder writes .DS_Store) is left alone.

cases.message_equals: usa: fetch: ProviderError: tiingo USA: HTTP 429
cases.derivation: The first failure stops the run: nothing more is fetched, nothing is written, and last run's gbf.json is untouched.
USA's rows stop in July: it doesn't reach the as-of month (section 7.2), so nothing is published for anyone.
The benchmark's August row is stale (20th of a 31-day month). The benchmark feeds every file, so the run stops before any asset is fetched.

cases.message_equals: fx: fetch: ProviderError: alphavantage GBP/USD: timed out
cases.derivation: The exchange rate is named fx.
An error type that isn't one of the pipeline's own is reported by type only: its message could hold anything, here a value and a key.
The folder may hold only this run's files. A file from a removed instrument could otherwise go on being published. Checked before anything is fetched.
A leftover temporary file means an earlier run was interrupted: stop and let Avi look.
The benchmark has no file, so trk.json is unexpected.
A subfolder is unexpected too.
The instrument list is checked before anything else.
A date and time, not a date.
run() never creates the folder; the command does.
The crypto's start month has no rows. The start is never moved (section 7.4), and the last asset's failure still means nothing is written for the first two.
